heroTitle: AI-powered chat & support for your online store
heroSubtitle: ShopTalk answers your customers 24/7, hands off to your team when it matters, and speaks their language — English, Spanish, Korean, Vietnamese, Japanese and Chinese.
featureAiDesc: A knowledge-base-backed assistant resolves common questions instantly, with every reply passing moderation before it reaches a customer.
featureChatDesc: Live chat with routing to your consultants — conversation history, canned replies and full context included.
featureCommerceDesc: Shopify-connected: orders, customers and campaigns are right next to the conversation.
featureI18nDesc: Customers chat in any of six languages — the widget and the AI follow their language automatically.
